meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档内容拆成事实、解释、风险、行动四类卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在阅读资料后快速提炼出事实要点、潜在风险与可执行行动。
copy.tagline_en: Turn documents into fact, explanation, risk, and action cards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn reading notes into facts, risks, and next steps.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户提供文档和意图时，Claude 会生成四张卡片：事实蓝卡（附来源）、解释绿卡、风险黄卡（标注不确定性）、行动红卡；每张卡都带来源与生成方式，可溯源。也可通过脚本分阶段生成。
howto.when: 在用户给出待分析文档并表达分析意图（如要求生成四色卡片）时触发；也支持运行脚本分阶段执行。

say.text: 请根据这份研报生成四色卡片。
say.note: 输出蓝绿黄红四张卡片。

say.text: 运行 extract 阶段抽取事实蓝卡。
用 review 阶段检查过度声明，出黄卡。

howto.what_en: When given a document and intent, Claude generates four cards: blue (facts with sources), green (explanation), yellow (risks with uncertainty), red (actions); every card is traceable. It can also run in stages via script.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a document and asks for analysis such as four-color cards; also runnable via the provided script.

say_en.text: Generate four-color cards from this research report.
Run the extract stage to get blue fact cards.
Use the review stage to check overclaims and produce yellow cards.
